snippet.title: Ledgerbound - Mid-Quest Review Trailer | Women Led Games Showcase: The Game Awards Edition
snippet.description:
It’s time for Rayna’s mid-quest review and a quick recap of what you’ll need to accomplish in order to succeed, courtesy of HR. This trailer was first released as part of the Women Led Games Showcase: The Game Awards Edition 2025.

Eldarra’s greatest heroes have been felled, but, more importantly than that: if your company has to pay their life insurance policy, you’re out of a job. Leave your cushy life of simulating battles behind and step onto the battlefield to prove the policyholders’ fault and save the world in Ledgerbound, a hilarious narrative-driven tactics RPG.

Meet the voice actors behind some of Heroes United Life Group’s finest heroes:
✒️ Rayna (played by Heather Gonzalez)
🐀 Hobknob (played by Todd Haberkorn)
📜 Jazz (played by Stephanie Kerbis)
👑 Avarice (played by Matt Mercer)
🔥 Sylvie (Cherami Leigh)
🖤 Joy (Shelby Young)
⚔️ Pallas (Delbert Hunt)
🤖 Aura (Melissa Medina)
🤵🏻‍♂️ Grigsby (John Patneaude)
🐶 Merp (Craig Lee Thomas)

____________________
